note: North Ground readings of authority text, for presentation only. The ORIGINAL is never replaced: it keeps its language, its owner, its citation identity and its provenance, and every surface that shows a reading keeps the original one action away. Nothing here is read by the regulatory engine — interpretation runs on canonical data, never on translated prose. Each row is keyed by the source text VERBATIM AND COMPLETE: if the authority changes a word the key misses and the interface says no reading exists, rather than showing yesterday's reading of today's rule. Proper names, official designations and the authority's own category names are NOT translated (CLAUDE.md §47) and are carried through unchanged. Every row here is NORTH_GROUND_GENERATED: it has been written by North Ground and NOT signed off by a person. Promotion to NORTH_GROUND_REVIEWED is a human act.

readings.from: « Territoires où toute activité de chasse est interdite. » (Réserve écologique).
readings.into: “Territory where all hunting activity is prohibited.” (Réserve écologique).
readings.note: The parenthetical is the ministry's own layer category and is kept verbatim: « Réserve écologique » is a designation in Québec law, not a description.

readings.from: « Territoires où toute activité de chasse est interdite. » (Parc national).
readings.into: “Territory where all hunting activity is prohibited.” (Parc national).
readings.note: « Parc national » is Québec's own designation for a provincial park and is kept verbatim; rendering it "national park" would name the wrong order of government.

readings.from: « La chasse est permise à partir d’une demi-heure avant le lever du soleil jusqu’à midi. »
readings.into: “Hunting is permitted from half an hour before sunrise until noon.”
readings.note: Québec's wild turkey hours. This is a reading for a hunter, not a substitute for the provision: the original stays beside it and remains what the rule says.

readings.from: La chasse est permise à partir d’une demi-heure avant le lever du soleil jusqu’à midi.

readings.note: The same sentence as published, without the quotation marks a caller may add.

readings.from: Tout orignal dont les bois mesurent 10 cm ou plus (complément de la définition d’orignal sans bois).
readings.into: Any moose whose antlers measure 10 cm or more (the complement of the definition of an antlerless moose).

readings.from: Femelle, ou mâle dont les bois mesurent moins de 7 cm.
